content: net10.0 protocol client transport: use in-box System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket (custom Origin header, KeepAliveInterval/KeepAliveTimeout) plus System.IO.Pipelines 10.0.12 for length-prefixed WA frame parsing; .NET 10 adds WebSocketStream (Stream wrapper over WebSocket, new - verify framing semantics before use). Third-party WebSocket.Client 5.5.1 (MIT) rejected: hides framing and reconnect policy control needed for Noise re-handshake/resume. Versions from NuGet v3 API + dotnet release metadata. Confidence HIGH.
